title: Work item details are viewable from the dashboard
description: A work item's details render as a pop-up card with the full details; the in-flight item's title and id are clickable; each grouping in the pipeline is clickable and lists its items by title.
acceptance_criteria: The card and both pop-ups render from fixtures in every state; every value is escaped under the existing content security policy; a grouping with no items says so.
notes: Goal served: the harness's surfaces read clearly.
citation: (P2, dashboard) Work item details are viewable from the dashboard (yoyodyne-ifd.432.1)
